items.text: The cost of building on an ungoverned data layer.

Power Platform makes it easy to build applications quickly, but many organizations build them on data scattered across SharePoint lists, spreadsheets, and standalone databases. Without a governed data foundation, that speed becomes technical debt.
See how we fix this
01  No single source of truth
The same records live in several places at once. Applications disagree, reports conflict, and teams lose confidence in the numbers they are given.
02  Security and compliance gaps
Data spread across lists and files is difficult to secure consistently. Access is hard to prove, and audit requirements turn into a manual effort every time they arise.
03  Applications that cannot scale
A weak or informal data model works for one app and breaks under many. Performance degrades, and every new requirement means reworking what came before.
04  Unpredictable capacity costs
Storage grows without oversight and table design goes unmanaged, so Dataverse capacity charges arrive as a surprise rather than as part of a plan.

items.text: Dataverse consulting services, from data model to production.
Folio3 Azure delivers Microsoft Dataverse as a governed, enterprise-ready data platform. As a Microsoft partner, we cover the full scope of Dataverse work under one accountable team.
Explore our Dataverse services
Data modeling and architecture
We design the tables, relationships, keys, and business rules that turn scattered records into one coherent, relational model built to grow with the organization.
Migration to Dataverse
We move data from SharePoint, Excel, Access, and SQL Server into Dataverse with mapping, cleansing, and validation, so the platform starts on data teams can trust.

Integration

items.text: Dataverse capacity and licensing, in plain terms.

Dataverse is licensed and metered through Microsoft, and cost depends heavily on how the data is modeled and stored. Folio3 Azure assesses capacity during discovery, so cost is understood before the build begins.
Get a capacity assessment
Database, file, and log capacity
Dataverse meters storage in separate categories. Modeling and archival decisions directly affect which category grows and how quickly.
Table types
Standard, elastic, and virtual tables serve different needs. Choosing the right type controls both performance and storage cost.
Included with Power Platform and Dynamics 365
Many licenses include a Dataverse entitlement. Folio3 Azure helps determine what is already covered before recommending additional capacity.

items.text: Frequently Asked Questions
What technology leaders ask before committing to Dataverse.

SharePoint lists and spreadsheets have limited structure, security, and scale. Dataverse provides a true relational model, enforced relationships, fine-grained security, and native Power Platform integration, so applications built on it remain reliable as they grow rather than breaking under load.

Dataverse includes a security model, business logic, auditing, and Power Platform connectivity out of the box, which a raw SQL database does not. For solutions built on Power Platform and Dynamics 365, Dataverse removes a large amount of custom integration and security work that a separate database would require.

Migration is handled as a controlled process. Data is mapped, cleansed, validated, and reconciled before cutover, and scope and timing are confirmed during discovery, so the move happens in a planned way rather than as an abrupt switch.

Cost is driven largely by data modeling and storage decisions. Folio3 Azure plans table types, storage, and archival deliberately and assesses existing license entitlements during discovery, so capacity is predictable rather than a recurring surprise.

Dataverse supports role, row, and column-level security, along with environment strategy and data loss prevention policies. Access follows the organization's existing identity and compliance controls, and can be demonstrated for audits.

Dynamics 365 already runs on Dataverse. An engagement in that case focuses on extending the existing model correctly, consolidating additional data into it, and governing it, rather than introducing a new platform.

Dataverse is the right foundation for solutions built on Power Platform and Dynamics 365 that need governance, security, and scale. For very large analytical or high-volume transactional workloads, Folio3 Azure will recommend the appropriate Azure data service instead, and advise honestly during discovery.

Yes. Well-structured, well-secured Dataverse data is the foundation Copilot Studio agents and Power BI need to produce reliable results. Folio3 Azure models Dataverse so intelligence has trustworthy, governed data to work from.
